items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 44:1
items.html: The Rosh of Yeshsut clothed, from below upward, this entire place of the four kings of HGT, and it is the discernment of expansion whose way is to fill the empty vessels and the records of the body of the one above. Therefore it illuminated to these records of the four kings of HGT, which are the discernment of the body of the one above it, namely of AVI, and drew them to their place in the new vessels, in order to clothe them. (p. 555, Sub Header, “And behold”)
